finding.confirmed: Non-atomic native history may publish synthetic interrupted despite the exact known live turn. History read across a lifecycle transition can publish a mixed snapshot and grant completeness. Early completion before scheduler acceptance needs exact terminal evidence when history remains stale.
finding.originalHostedFailureCausality: Not reproduced. Baseline Windows and Linux bounded sequential probes passed. One parallel stress probe failed at native startup before scheduler; this is separate and its cause is unconfirmed.

solution: Per-activity turn lifecycle counter independent of streaming revisions; per-traversal identity/lifecycle/unknown fence.
Only exact same-thread same-turn known live status or last explicit terminal notification projects existing history rows. No inferred or fabricated turns/items; stable cold interrupted remains.
Terminal evidence cache bounded to one per retained activity; cleared on close/delete/unsubscribe/revert. Unknown stays unknown.
testContracts: Paginated/legacy known live exact-ID projection; unrelated old IDs untouched.
Cold completed/failed/interrupted and status-only active remain native.
Streaming item delta does not stale history.
Completion between turn/timeline reads rejects and revokes write proof.
Lifecycle between cursor requests rejects before another native request, deletes traversal.
Accepted turn/start without notification changes lifecycle and fences concurrent history.
Unknown does not project live status or become certain after history/terminal read.
Only most-recent exact terminal notification, same thread, overrides; missing turns are never fabricated.
Close/delete/revert invalidate terminal evidence and inflight traversal.

Actual RuntimeService+Dispatcher+AutomationScheduler+Ledger deterministic early completion before accept, stale interrupted history and stale inProgress metadata: completed once, accepted original receipt, one start, zero interrupt, zero lease, no resurrection.
boundaries: No full suite, deployment, online login, paid inference or external MCP calls.
Official CLI tests only loopback substitute and isolated homes.
Native failure diagnostic retains at most32 ID/status notification summaries and failure-only run/activity metadata; no request spy, delay, extra retry or weakened completion assertion.
